Prioritization without budget

Source: R/fct_prioritization_with_budget.R
prioritization_with_budget.Rd

Generate a prioritization without a budget.

Usage

prioritization_with_budget(
  site_ids,
  feature_ids,
  action_ids,
  pu_data,
  status_data,
  zone_data,
  goal_data,
  weight_data,
  locked_data,
  budget,
  max_budget,
  parameters,
  gap = 0,
  verbose = TRUE,
  time_limit = .Machine$integer.max
)

Arguments

site_ids

character site identifiers.

feature_ids

character feature identifiers.

action_ids

character action identifiers.

pu_data

list containing raw planning unit data as data.frame and cost normalized planning unit data as either data.frame or NULL.

status_data

dat.frame containing status data.

zone_data

dat.frame containing zone data.

goal_data

dat.frame containing goal data.

weight_data

dat.frame containing weight data.

locked_data

dat.frame containing locked out data.

budget

numeric budget.

parameters

list object with configuration parameters.

gap

numeric optimality gap. Defaults to 0.

verbose

logical display information during optimization? Defaults to TRUE.

time_limit

integer Maximum amount of time (seconds) to spend during optimization. Defaults to the maximum integer value.

Value

list object containing results of prioritization.
